title: Climate and Gesture Controls
summary: Feedback centers on climate-control setup and gesture-control usability, with a few clear likes and dislikes but many fragments that are only descriptive or unresolved.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention liking the continued inclusion of gesture control and asking about or appreciating climate-control configuration and touchscreen access.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dislike of the controls overall and frustration that seat heating requires turning on climate control.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe instructions, troubleshooting, or unresolved issues involving climate settings, fogging, range impact, and gesture control not working.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a clear sentiment pattern.
The topic mixes several related but distinct subjects, including climate-control settings, seat-heating interaction, touchscreen access, and gesture-control operation.
Some potentially opinionated fragments are labeled undetermined, so they cannot be reassigned to another sentiment here.
Examples are limited, so coverage of specific control features is incomplete.
